response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills and recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) work. While his direct experience with production-grade GenAI systems is limited, his technical leadership, cloud platform familiarity, and open-source contributions suggest adaptability. The role's emphasis on customer-facing technical leadership and agentic workflows aligns with his current work at re:cinq, but deeper GenAI/RAG expertise is unproven.
strengths: Proven technical leadership across diverse domains (full-stack, cloud, AI tooling) with 10+ years of experience.
Direct experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic workflows at re:cinq, aligning with key job technologies.
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective) and mentorship, demonstrating initiative and knowledge-sharing.
concerns: Limited explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions (GenAI/RAG focus is recent).
No mention of vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures in resume, despite job requirements.
Staff-level roles emphasize consulting and cross-functional leadership, which are less documented than hands-on contributions.
